name: ensemble cast
description: Join an Ensemble multi-persona session as one seat from your own Claude Code session. Connects Ensemble's per-session MCP server, primes the session with the named persona, and waits for turn / buzz-check events from the scheduler.

arguments.name: persona
arguments.description: Persona ID or filename to load (e.g. 'keith' or 'specs/keith.md').

arguments.name: session_url
arguments.description: Ensemble session join URL. If omitted, the command prompts for one and validates it before connecting.

arguments.name: seat
arguments.description: Override the seat slot to bind to. Defaults to whichever seat the session URL claims.

outputs.name: transcript_stream
outputs.description: Streaming text the persona produces during its turns; surfaced back to Ensemble via stdout.
